turnos.google_desconectar_confirmar: Disconnect Google Calendar? Appointments will no longer be created there.
turnos.vacio: No appointments booked yet. Share your booking link so they start coming in.
turnos.copiar_link_cliente: Copy the link so the customer can change or cancel their appointment
turnos.serv_hint: What your customers can book, with the duration of each one.
turnos.rec_hint: Which channel to use to tell the customer their appointment is confirmed and to remind them the day before.
turnos.rec_email_det: Free. Only arrives if the customer enters their email when booking (it is optional for them).
turnos.rec_wa_det: There is a cost per message, paid by the business (see details below).
turnos.rec_meta: Meta charges for WhatsApp messages a business sends outside the 24 hours after a customer's last message. The appointment confirmation and reminder are messages the business starts on its own — not a reply to something the customer wrote — so that rate applies to both. The charge goes to the card you add yourself to your Meta Business account. That is why this channel is off by default: you turn it on when you decide to take on that cost.
turnos.rec_tarifa_generica: The per-message rate depends on your country and the message category (Utility); check the current rate in Meta's official WhatsApp Business pricing documentation.
turnos.disp_hint: A single schedule for the whole business - appointments are spread within this window.
turnos.prof_hint: If your business has several people serving customers (e.g. a hair salon with several stylists), add them here with their own schedule - your customers will have to choose who they want the appointment with when booking, and each staff member can have an appointment at the same time as another. If you leave the list empty, a single schedule is used for the whole business (the one under "Availability").
turnos.sena_hint: If you turn it on, your customers will have to pay a deposit with Mercado Pago as soon as they book - the appointment stays "pending" until they pay (they have 15 minutes), and only then is it confirmed and you get notified. The money goes straight to YOUR Mercado Pago account, not FrontyBack's.
turnos.mp_desconectar_confirmar: Disconnect Mercado Pago? If the deposit was turned on, it turns itself off.
turnos.sena_pedir: Ask for a deposit when booking
turnos.sena_pedir_det: Requires Mercado Pago to be connected (above).
turnos.emp_hint: Each employee only sees the leads of the department you assign. You (Management) still see everything.
turnos.emp_ninguno: You haven't added any employees yet.
turnos.emp_confirmar_borrar: Delete this employee? They will no longer be able to log in to the CRM.
